I like Fixer. One Handelabra video suggests that he fixes problems, and that can be true. So long as he deals damage with Riveting Crane, then everyone cuts through the Damage reduction. Or he can bypass it alone with ATC to get rid of a high Def problem. Or he can redirect.

Was playing Mr. Fixer on the app last night and had a very weird circumstance that I'm guessing wasn't play as intended.  I had SST use Experiment to play cards from the bottom of Mr. Fixer's deck.  Out come TWO OVERDRIVES.  I was like crap, that's annoying, but at least they'll be in my trash.  But then low and behold the app lets me use Strike 4 times! If you play overdrive as a result of some other means, does that mean you get to use strike twice immediatelly, or is it intended to allow you to use it twice IF you first get a power usage? Actually that was the second weird thing in the same game.  I also had Expatriatte out with Pride, Prejudice, and Tactical Shotgun.  I played Unload, so I have 3 powers.  First power, Load to play an ammo, second power, Pride, then I wanted to use Prejudice as a "free" power with shotgun at the end, but the app counted Prejudice as my third power and forced me to move on to draw.  So what I had to do was go back and use in order Load, then Shotgun, then Pride with a free Prejudice.

I'm pretty sure you should have gotten only 2 strikes.  Because of the way it's worded, Overdrive gives you 2 bonus strikes when played on someone else's turn, but it doesn't stack.  The "2 uses of strike" provided by Overdrive overlap with, but are seperate from, the regular power use.  If Fixer has been granted another power (e.g. from Plague Rat, or Cosmic Weapon), he can actually use 3 powers in a turn.  Play Overdrive, then use the other power for the main power use.  He can still use Strike twice, which totals to 3 powers.

 

Unload behaved correctly.  Like Fixer above, Pride lets you fire Prejudice regardless of whether you normally would be allowed to, but it still counts as a power use towards your total power use quota.
